title: Q-CLAIM-COVER-docs-runbooks-any-tools-README-md: unbound claim-like statements on docs/runbooks/any-tools/README.md
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/claims.json::"surface": "docs/runbooks/any-tools/README.md"
**Status:** open

COVERAGE-1: 2 claim-like lines (first 28) on `docs/runbooks/any-tools/README.md` state a number, cadence or guarantee with no registered claim and probe.
